_comment: Spend from a 2-of-3 multisig. List the private keys you hold under 'keys' (or none at all). With fewer than 2 you get a PSBT to hand to the next cosigner: btc-keytool sign <psbt> --key-file <key>

inputs._prev_tx: Recommended: add "prev_tx": "<raw hex of the transaction that funded this address>". The PSBT then proves the amount, and the other cosigners can sign without --trust-amounts.
